1371.1001.0.description:
Log TestSet setup outcome

Test-harness step (not a functional test): logs the per-test-set setup outcome before the set's functional cases run. Excluded from manual-test coverage mapping.

1371.1001.1.description:
IPv4 unicast performance with UDP packets

[Log-derived analysis] Routed IPv4 unicast UDP throughput/performance test driven by an external traffic generator. Configures the switch with static ARP entries and static routes between two IP subnets so traffic is L3-forwarded, then sweeps a UDP stream across a range of frame sizes from small to full-size and measures the maximum achievable forwarding rate at each size. Confirms the traffic test completes, restores the original TestSet configuration and verifies it matches the baseline, and checks the stack reports the expected member count with no exceptions.
